sections.content:
After clicking ring center again:
- p stayed at (38, 31) - no movement
- G stayed at (56, 24)
- W stayed at (21, 39)
So clicking the ring center again didn't move p. The first time I clicked the ring center (after eliminating G), p moved from (57, 25) to (38, 31). But clicking it again didn't move p further.
This suggests that clicking the ring center only works once, or only works when G has just been eliminated.
Let me think about the sequence:
1. G was at (60, 28), I clicked G to eliminate it
2. Then I clicked ring center, and p moved from (57, 25) to (38, 31)
3. Now clicking ring center again doesn't move p
Maybe the sequence needs to be: eliminate G, then click ring, then eliminate G again, then click ring again?
Or maybe I need to click on p now to move it toward the ring.
Let me try clicking on p to see if it moves.
